pieces.Text: You become a conduit for the power of your god. Your DR increases to 10/evil. Whenever you use smite evil and successfully strike an aberration, the creature must make a Will save (DC

) or be banished to oblivion. This ability does not kill the creature, but it is sent to a remote place, such as deep underground or far into space (if it is a creature native to space), and cannot return under its own power for at least 100 years. Whenever the paladin channels positive energy or uses lay on hands to heal a creature, she heals the maximum possible amount.
